pre_registered_analysis.discount_boundary: k=0 at first restored decision; no pre-prefix return and no value bootstrap at native termination
pre_registered_analysis.no_selection: no preference changes, dropping parents/repeats, significance retries or heldout access

pre_registered_analysis.tie: abs(paired difference)<=1e-6 is descriptive only; retain unrounded data in inference
